comments.why: Covers police militarization and police versus military.
comments.text: BTW, 5 years old but more relevant than ever. It also touches on the difference between police and military: [VIDEO] US citizens deserve the same response in daily life from a police under the "serve and protect" banner that an enemy combatant gets from the opposing military during an active conflict? You can't treat every citizen as if they are the worst possible one. If you got this "you could be the worst ever" treatment in any other situation you would certainly not find acceptable to reference the fact that the army also does it while in a war.
